evidence: Adds `trigger_reorg()` to `test_framework/blocktools.py` and migrates multiple functional test suites from `invalidateblock` to fork-based reorganizations.
rationale: Deduplicating `trigger_reorg()` across the test framework and moving tests away from `invalidateblock` to realistic fork-based reorgs improves test realism and maintainability. Per the description, 'invalidateblock takes a different codepath than a reorg caused by a competing chain arriving,' making this a worthwhile framework cleanup with modest test fidelity improvements.
